title: Simple Sprout Shop Logo
tests: Produces a usable simple logo combining a clear mark and a readable business name.

faults.what: An unrequested large gray rectangle behind the white lettering interrupts the requested plain white background.
The large gap between the sprout and the name makes the logo feel disconnected.

judge.summary: The square logo has a clear green sprout and correctly spelled name, but the gray text panel departs from the requested simple design on white.

must_haves.why: The name is correctly spelled and clearly legible.

must_haves.item: A recognizable, simple green sprout sits above the name.
must_haves.why: A simple green two-leaf sprout is centered above the text.
Although the surrounding canvas is white, a large gray rectangular panel sits behind the name.

must_haves.item: The square image contains a flat logo, not a photograph or merchandise mockup.
must_haves.why: The square image contains flat graphic elements and text, with no photograph or merchandise mockup.
